model: RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, 500 trees, random_state=42), trained on 691 rows
notes: Exact duplicate rows (57) were removed before a stratified 80/20 split (864 rows; 691 train, 173 test). Zeros in glucose/blood_pressure/skin_thickness/insulin/bmi were kept as-is; 5-fold CV on train gave 0.842 mean accuracy, so the 0.913 test score is likely optimistic.
